summary: Backend-only testing for Air Navigation Maintenance API. Created comprehensive pytest suite (19 tests) covering auth (login admin success/fail, /auth/me with/without/invalid token), departments list (14 Arabic items verified), admin employee CRUD (create, duplicate→400, list, delete, employee→403 on admin routes), activities (create with valid/invalid department, /activities/me scoping, owner-only delete, non-owner→404), admin filtering by department, weekly report default + custom week_start. All 19 tests PASSED (100%). Verified MongoDB _id never leaks in any response (login user, /me, employees list, activities, weekly report groups/activities). Verified password_hash not exposed. Default admin seed (admin/12345) works on startup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') – consider switching to lifespan context managers (FastAPI >=0.93). Not blocking.
JWT_SECRET defaults to a random uuid if env var missing, which means tokens invalidate on every backend restart. Acceptable for dev but should be set explicitly via env in production.
delete_my_activity returns 404 when a non-owner employee tries to delete – this matches the spec ('non-owner gets 404'), which is good (avoids enumeration).
Single-file server.py is currently 362 lines which is fine, but if features grow split into routers/auth/models modules.

ALLOWED_DEPARTMENTS validation present in POST /api/activities but not used to constrain query string in GET /api/admin/activities?department=... – passing an invalid dept silently returns empty list (not a bug, but could be a 400 for stricter API).
seed_data_creation: Test employees (TEST_emp_pytest, TEST_del_emp, TEST_other_emp) and their activities are created and torn down automatically inside the test fixtures – no residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://maintenance-crew-3.preview.emergentagent.com is fully functional. Admin seeded as admin/12345. All 14 Arabic departments validated. Use /app/backend/tests/test_maintenance_api.py as regression suite. For future frontend testing, mobile viewport 375x667, expect Expo Router screens; ensure testID attributes on login form, dept dropdown, and add-activity form.
